segments.ja200:1.3: Brāhmaṇaṃ teva pucchāma, kannu tesaṃ vanimhase [vaṇimhase (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja200:2.1: Attho atthi sarīrasmiṃ, vuḍḍhabyassa namo kare;
segments.ja200:2.3: Attho atthi sujātasmiṃ, sīlaṃ asmāka ruccatīti.
segments.ja200:5.3: Atha muttimavāṇija umhayate, ciraāgata koṭṭha sarīra dasāti.
